title: Ubutumwa mu Mujyi wa Kera
intro: Umurwa wa kera wuzuye ivumbi, abaturage bawo bahora mu guhakana, n'umuburo wa nyuma utitaweho. Uyu munsi, jya mu mwanya w'aboherejwe na Allah gutanga ubutumwa ku bantu b'intagondwa. Inkuru yo kwangwa, ijwi ry'ukwemera, n'iherezo rifunze n'itegeko risenya. Ni nde uvuga binyuze muri ibi bimenyetso?
clues: Imana yatwohereje mu mujyi abantu bawo bari barataye ukuri
Babiri muri twe ni bo babanje, hanyuma uwa gatatu arafatanya kugira ngo dukomeze ubutumwa bwacu
Abaturage bo mu mujyi baratwanze, bavuga ko turi abantu nka bo gusa
Umuntu umwe rukumbi waturutse ku mpera y'umujyi yiruka abwira abantu ngo badukurikire
Twarabasabye imbabazi, ariko bakojeje imitima yabo baraduhindukirana
Mu ijwi rimwe ribabaje riturutse mu ijuru, umujyi wacu wose waratuje

identity.label: Ndi nde?
options: Abapfumu bo mu rugo rwa Farawo

trial.label: Igeragezwa/Ikibazo
options: Abaturage bo mu mujyi banze kandi bise abanyabinyoma
Yatwitswe ari muzima mu muriro ukomeye ugurumana
Yamizwe n'ifi nini mu nyanja nini
Bahatiwe gukora imirimo yo kubaka inkingi ndende
trial.answer: Abaturage bo mu mujyi banze kandi bise abanyabinyoma

outcome.label: Ibisubizo
options: Umujyi warasenyutse kubera ijwi rimwe ryangizaga (Sayha)
Uwo mugome n'ingabo ze barohamye mu nyanja yari yaragabanutse
Imvura y'amabuye yaturutse mu ijuru yasenye umujyi
outcome.answer: Umujyi warasenyutse kubera ijwi rimwe ryangizaga (Sayha)

arabic: إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍۢ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُم مُّرْسَلُونَ
verse: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened [them] with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you." (36:14)
